data.heading: WeeklyRecurringEvent
data.text: A WeeklyRecurringEvent recurs on the regularly on the same day of the week, as specified by the schema:dayOfWeek property.

data.heading: Organization
data.text:
A collection of people organized together into a community or other social, commercial or political structure. The group has some common purpose or reason for existence which goes beyond the set of people belonging to it. An organization may itself be able to act as an agent.
        In addition to the standard org:Organization pattern, this ontology defines an cdm1:Organization to be a subclass of an cdm1:Agent.

data.heading: Geo_Position_unit
data.text: Reference systems to indicate geographic position.

data.heading: length
data.text: Length is the amount of space between two geographical points along a curve. It is a base quantity in the International System of Units and other systems of units. Length is speed times time. The metre, a base unit of length in the International System of Units, is defined in terms of speed of light during a certain time interval.

data.heading: ratio
data.text: A ratio is a comparison of two quantities, often expressed as a fraction or in the form a:b.

data.heading: volume
data.text: Volume is a measure of how much three-dimensional space any phenomenon occupies.

data.heading: AgentThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all classes defined in the Agent pattern.

data.heading: time unit
data.text: A specified system of units for time.

data.heading: ConjunctiveAgreement
data.text: A conjunctive agreement is a complex agreement where all sub-agreements must be satisfied for the overall agreement to hold.

data.heading: RecurringEventThing
data.text: Class added for organizational purposes only; to group all classes defined in the recurring-event ontology.

data.heading: length unit
data.text: A specified system of units for distance.

data.heading: State
data.text:
A State describes some situation in the world which may or may not be satisfied (true) at a given point in time. A State refers to a class of manifestations. It may be a precondition or effect of some Activity, or more generally it may be enabled or be caused by some Activity. If a state is complex, it may refer to some combination of classes of manifestations.
        Example: A shopping activity, Activity-Shop, can require both the VehicleW30LGas state, but also some state wherein the mall is

data.heading: speed
data.text: Speed is the time rate of motion measured by the distance moved over in unit time.

data.heading: Location
data.text: A location.

data.heading: SpatialLocThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all classes defined in the Location pattern of the CDM ontology.

data.heading: ActivityStatus
data.text: The status of the Activity.

data.heading: area
data.text: Area expresses the two-dimensional size of a defined part of a surface, typically a region bounded by a closed curve. It is a derived quantity in the International System of Units. Area is length squared.

data.heading: area unit
data.text: Unit of area in the specified system of units.

data.heading: duration
data.text: Duration is the amount of time that elapses between two instants or events.

data.heading: Resource
data.text:
A Resource is a generic representation of some Thing that can be "used" in an Activity.
        A Resource may have some Location, amount or availability, according to the definition of the Manifestation or TimeVaryingEntity.
        A Resource must be classified as some Resource Type.
        A Resource may participate in some Activity Occurrence. In other words, it links to the Activity that the Resource is being used/consumed/produced/released at the time of the manifestation.
        A spe

data.heading: DisjunctiveState
data.text: A type of NonTerminalState that is defined by the disjunction of its child States. A State cannot be both conjunctive and disjunctive.

data.heading: FoundationalCdmThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all classes defined in the Foundation-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: ReleaseState
data.text: Identifies a Resource and Quantity it releases (after using).

data.heading: NonDivisibleResource
data.text: A Resource that can only be used for a single Activity at once - even if it isn't fully utilized.

data.heading: ProduceState
data.text: Identifies a Resource and Quantity it produces.

data.heading: AgreementThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all classes defined in the Agreement pattern.

data.heading: volume unit
data.text: A specified system of units for volume.

data.heading: Atomic Agreement
data.text: An atomic agreement is a simple agreement that cannot be further decomposed into sub-agreements. It is a subclass of Agreement and specifies the “essence” of an agreement.  In particular it identifies how agents participating in the agreement are involved: whether they have a claim, duty, no-claim or privilege with respect to some activity that is committed to in the agreement.

data.heading: DisjunctiveAgreement
data.text: A disjunctive agreement is a complex agreement where at least one sub-agreement must be satisfied for the overall agreement to hold.

data.heading: UseState
data.text: Identifies a Resource and Quantity it uses (without consuming).

data.heading: ActivityThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all classes defined in the Activity pattern.

data.heading: mass
data.text: Mass is the amount of matter of a phenomenon. It is a base quantity in the International System of Units. Mass is force divided by acceleration.

data.heading: Complex Agreement
data.text: A complex agreement is an agreement that is composed of two or more atomic agreements. It is a subclass of Agreement and specifies the “essence” of a complex agreement.  In particular it identifies how atomic agreements are composed to form a complex agreement.

data.heading: speed unit
data.text: A specified system of units for speed.

data.heading: CityUnitsThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes to group the classes defined in the City Units portion of the CDM.

data.heading: Agent
data.text: An Agent affects, is affected by, or performs some Activity(s). An Agent may be a Person or Organization, but not Software or a Mechanical Device (at this time). An Agent can be a member of an organization and hold zero or more posts in an organization.

data.heading: NonTerminalState
data.text: A NonTerminalState has child States (a.k.a., sub-states) that are either conjuctive or disjunctive. Each child may be a TerminalState or NonTerminalState; eventually a TerminalState is reached. A State cannot be both non-terminal and terminal.

data.heading: ConjunctiveState
data.text: A type of NonTerminalState that is defined by the conjunction of its child States.

data.heading: TerminalState
data.text: A terminal state type has no substates (cannot be decomposed). It corresponds to a particular class of manifestations. A terminal state is achieved at some time if and only if there exists a manifestation within its defined classification, that exists at that time.

data.heading: RecurringEvent
data.text: Recurring events are defined based on the regular interval at which they occur; this is captures using some combination of the hasTime, dayOfWeek, hasMonth, and dayOfMonth properties.  Using these properties, ontology defines the following specializations of the RecurringEvent class. Other subclasses may be defined similarly, as required.

data.heading: Activity
data.text:
An Activity describes something that occurs in the domain.
An Activity may be further defined by (decomposed into) Subactivities.
An Activity may have precondition and/or effect State.
An Activity may be enabled by or cause some State. An enabling of causing state is a generalization of a precondition/effect; an Activity is enabled by or causes some State if it has a subactivity with a precondition or effect (respectively) of that State.
In other words, the state may not be required directly be

data.heading: ExceptionDay
data.text: An ExceptionDay specifies a day or days that recursExcept and recursAddition use to specify unique days that do not recur on the same day each year, for example, holidays.

data.heading: MonthlyRecurringEvent
data.text: A MonthlyRecurringEvent recurs regularly on the same day of each month, as specified by the dayOfMonth data property. Note that there is often ambiguity regarding the semantics of a monthly recurring event: in this formalization, a MonthlyRecurringEvent is any event that recurs regularly on the same day of each month; other interpretations sometimes consider events that recur on the same day of week, or first or last day, in which case the day of month will vary.

data.heading: OrganizationThing
data.text: A class representing an organization in the context of the CDM ontology.

data.heading: PlannedAllocation
data.text:
Specifies the planned allocation of a resource to an activity via a state.
        Note that Allocation is a Manifestation as the allocation may change over time.

data.heading: MonetaryValue
data.text: A Monetary Value has a numerical value that is relative to a particular date (year). A Monetary Value is measured with some currency.

data.heading: CdmThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all classes defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: DailyRecurringEvent
data.text: A DailyRecurringEvent is a RecurringEvent that occurs every day. It has a maximum of one associated time, the start time. Typically, a daily recurring event will occur at the same time every day, but it is also possible that no commitment is made to a recurring start time for the event, in which case no start time is specified. A DailyEvent does not necessarily have the same endtime or duration, therefore these are not specified.

data.heading: ManifestationState
data.text: A specialization of TerminalState, the ManifestationState specifies a Manifestation class that an individual must satisfy in order for the ManifestationState to be true.

data.heading: ValueOfMoney
data.text: An amount of money that is defined relative to a particular year.

data.heading: Agreement
data.text: An agreement exists between two or more agents. It is established at some point in time and it may be considered valid only in some Location and/or for some interval in time. An agreement may be defined at varying levels of detail, this is supported with the introduction of the ComplexAgreement and AtomicAgreement class. Finally, agreements involve some specification of rights or commitments of the involved parties. This is represented as a relationship between the involved Agent and a particula

data.heading: ResourceThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all classes defined in the Resource ontology.

data.heading: DivisibleResource
data.text: A Resource that can be divided for use or consumption between multiple Activities.

data.heading: ChangeThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes to group the classes defined in the Change portion of the CDM.

data.heading: YearlyRecurringEvent
data.text: A YearlyRecurringEvent recurs regularly on the same day of the same month, as specified by the hasMonth and dayOfMonth properties. As with MonthlyRecurringEvent, there may be ambiguity regarding the semantics of a yearly recurring event, however this formalization captures only the notion of an event that recurs on the same day of the same month (e.g. a birthday).

data.heading: ConsumeState
data.text: Identifies a Resource and Quantity it consumes. The Quantity is removed from the Resource.

data.heading: Manifestation
data.text: Manifestations may be interpreted as “snapshots” of an object at some point in time. This enables the representation of changing attributes of an object, without losing information about its past values/relationships. The properties of the class must then be identified as properties that are (and aren't) subject to change, in order to distinguish between the static and dynamic aspects of a particular entity.

data.heading: FirstManifestation
data.text: The first recorded manifestation of an individual. No prior manifestations (in time) exist for the individual. It is a subclassOf Manifestation.

data.heading: MereologyObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all mereology object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: aggregateOf
data.text: One object within a collection.

data.heading: aggregationOf
data.text: A collection of objects.

data.heading: componentOf
data.text: Specifies a part-whole relationship between objects where the component is a part that is defined based on actual boundaries. The parts are often also defined according to distinct functions. For example, a headlight is a componentOf a car.

data.heading: hasComponent
data.text: Specifies a part-whole relationship between objects where the component is a part that is defined based on actual boundaries. The parts are often also defined according to distinct functions. For example, a car hasComponent headlight.

data.heading: hasProperPart
data.text: Specifies a part-whole relationship between objects where an object cannot be part of itself.

data.heading: immediateComponentOf
data.text: Specifies a componentOf relationship where the if x immediateComponentOf y, then there does not exist a z where x immediateComponentOf z immediateComponentOf y.

data.heading: partOf
data.text: Specifies a part-whole relationship between objects

data.heading: properPartOf
data.text: Specifies a part-whole relationship between objects where an object cannot be part of itself

data.heading: CdmObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: FoundationalCdmObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all foundational object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: ChangeObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all change object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: existsAt
data.text: Identifies the TemporalEntity that reflects the time Instant or Interval during which a Thing is valid.

data.heading: hasFirstManifestation
data.text: Identifies the First Manifestation that is related to a particular Manifestation (i.e., for some snapshot of an object, it identifies the first such snapshot of the object).

data.heading: hasLatestManifestation
data.text: Identifies the most recent Manifestation that is related to a particular FirstManifestation (i.e., for some snapshot of an object, it identifies the most recent snapshot of the object).

data.heading: hasManifestation
data.text: identifies a Manifestation that captures the instantiation of variant attributes of an object at some time (i.e., a temporal snapshot of some individual). The individual is related to all manifestations in a series via the hasManifestation property.

data.heading: hasNextManifestation
data.text: Identifies the immediate successor Manifestation (i.e. the subsequent snapshot of the object).

data.heading: hasPreviousManifestation
data.text: Identifies the immediate prior Manifestation (i.e. the prior snapshot of the object).

data.heading: precedesManifestation
data.text: Identifies all subsequent Manifestations that follow a FirstManifestation.

data.heading: CityUnitObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all city unit object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: AgentObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all agent object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: performs
data.text: Identifies activities that the Agent performs.

data.heading: RecurringEventObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all recurring event object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: beginsRecurringState
data.text: Defines a State that is required to be true in order to initiate the RecurringEvent.

data.heading: beginsRecurringTime
data.text: Specifies the start time of the RecurringEvent’s activity with a time:TemporalEntity from the Time pattern.

data.heading: endsRecurringState
data.text: Defines a State that is required to be true in order terminate the RecurringEvent.

data.heading: endsRecurringTime
data.text: Specifies the end time of the RecurringEvent’s activity with a time:TemporalEntity from the Time pattern

data.heading: hasDayOfWeek
data.text: Specifies the day of the week on which a Weekly RecurringEvent occurs with the time:DayOfWeek class from the Time pattern.

data.heading: hasOccurrence
data.text: Identifies the Activities that take place at the time and location.

data.heading: hasSubRecurringEvent
data.text: identifies the sub-recurring events that comprise the RecurringEvent. As with an Activity, a RecurringEvent may be decomposed/decomposed into simpler/more complex RecurringEvents to support varying levels of granularity.

data.heading: onDateTimeDescription
data.text: Specifies the date-time description (as defined in the Time pattern) on which a recurring event recurs. For example, the day of the month on which a MonthlyRecurringEvent recurs, or the day and month on which a YearlyRecurringEvent recurs.

data.heading: recursAddition
data.text: Defines a condition when the RecurringEvent should be added to. This can specify a time, day of the week, or specific dates.

data.heading: recursExcept
data.text: Defines the exceptions for the RecurringEvent, i.e. conditions when it does not occur. This can specify a time, day of the week, or specific dates.

data.heading: AgreementObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all agreement object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: commitsToActivity
data.text: A commitment to some activity

data.heading: establishedOn
data.text: Specifies the Instant of time at which the Agreement was created.

data.heading: hasClaim
data.text: Indicates that an Agent is the beneficiary of an Activity fulfilled by another Agent in the Agreement (i.e., the Agent with the duty to fulfil the Activity), e.g. payment of wages, provision of services.

data.heading: hasDuty
data.text: Indicates that an Agent is required to fulfil the described Activity.

data.heading: hasNoClaim
data.text: Indicates that an Agent has no claim on (i.e. has no right to the described Activity).

data.heading: hasPrivilege
data.text: Indicates that an Agent may but is not required to fulfil the described Activity.

data.heading: hasSubAgreement
data.text: Identifies two or more Agreements that comprise the Agreement.

data.heading: involvesAgent
data.text: Identifies the Agents that are party to the Agreement.

data.heading: validFor
data.text: Specifies the time Interval during which the Thing is valid or in force.

data.heading: validIn
data.text: Identifies the location where the Thing is valid.

data.heading: ResourceObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all resource object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: capacityInUse
data.text: Identifies the portion of capacity in use, by some Activity(s).

data.heading: forResource
data.text: Specifies the Resource that is allocated.

data.heading: forState
data.text: Specifies the State to which the Resource is allocated.

data.heading: hasAllocation
data.text: Specifies a Planned Allocation for the Resource. This indicates a State and time Interval to which the Resource has been allocated.

data.heading: hasAvailableCapacity
data.text: identifies the Quantity that specifies how much of the Resource is available for use.

data.heading: hasCapacity
data.text: Identifies the Quantity that specifies how much of the Resource exists, e.g. its volume, if it is liquid; how much it can hold, if it is an container.

data.heading: hasOwner
data.text: A Resource may have some owner. The owner of a resource is subject to change over time.

data.heading: hasQuantity
data.text: Specifies the Quantity of the Resource that participates in the State, if applicable.

data.heading: hasResource
data.text: Specifies a Resource that participates in the State. This identifies the condition of the object that plays a resource role (i.e. is used, consumed, etc.) when the state’s status is active.

data.heading: participatesIn
data.text: Identifies the Activity that the Resource is being used, consumed, produced, or released by.

data.heading: resourceOf
data.text: identifies what State the agent may be a resource of. This is specified using the Resource pattern, where the Agent would be considered to be a resource from the perspective of an Activity that uses it in some way. For example, a construction activity may use some persons(s) and those persons would be considered a Resource for that Activity.

data.heading: LocationObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all location object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: associatedLocation
data.text: Captures the association of a non-spatial object with a Location. For example, an activity is not a spatial object but may be associated with some location in which it (mostly) takes place.

data.heading: hasLocation
data.text: Specifies the Location of an object.

data.heading: ActivityObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all activity object properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: achievedAt
data.text: Identifies the time Interval or Instant during which the State was satisfied.

data.heading: beginOf
data.text: Identifies the time Instant at which the Activity occurs.

data.heading: causedByActivity
data.text: Identifies an Activity that in some (indirect) way caused the State to be realized. The causedByActivity property is the inverse of the causes property and is a generalization (super-property) of the effectOf property.

data.heading: causesState
data.text: Identifies a State that in some (indirect) way was caused by the occurrence of the Activity. An Activity is caused by a State if the State is an effect of the Activity or if the State is an effect of some subactivity of the Activity. The causes property is a generalization (super-property) of the hasEffect property.

data.heading: effectOf
data.text: Identifies an Activity that the State was realized by.

data.heading: enabledByState
data.text: Identifies a State that in some (indirect) way enabled the Activity to occur. An Activity is enabled by a State if the State is a precondition for the Activity or if the State is a precondition of some subactivity of the Activity. The enabledByState property is a generalization (super-property) of the hasPrecondition property.

data.heading: enablesActivity
data.text: Identifies an Activity that in some (indirect) way was enabled by the State. The enables property is the inverse of the enabledByState property and is a generalization (super-property) of the preconditionOf property.

data.heading: endOf
data.text: Identifies the time Instant at which the Activity ends.

data.heading: hasDecomp
data.text: Identifies two or more States into which the State may be immediately decomposed, i.e. its direct children.

data.heading: hasEffect
data.text: Identifies a State that is realized once the Activity has occurred.

data.heading: hasPrecondition
data.text: Identifies a State that must be realized in order for the Activity to occur.

data.heading: hasStatus
data.text: Identifies the status of the parent Thing at some point or interval in time.

data.heading: hasSubactivity
data.text: Identifies a more granular Activity into which the Activity may be decomposed.

data.heading: hasSubstate
data.text: Identifies a State into which the complex state decomposes, at any level (i.e. its child state, grandchild state, etc.). The hasSubState property is transitive and a super-property of the hasDecomp property.

data.heading: occursAt
data.text: Identifies a time Interval over which the Activity occurs.

data.heading: occursBefore
data.text: Identifies an Activity that the Activity occurred before.

data.heading: occursDirectlyBefore
data.text: Identifies an Activity that occurred immediately prior to the Activity. The occursDirectlyBefore property is a sub-property of the occursBefore property.

data.heading: preconditionOf
data.text: Identifies an Activity that requires the State to be realized in order to occur.

data.heading: satisfiedBy
data.text: Specifies the Manifestation that is to be satisfied (i.e., realized).

data.heading: scheduledFor
data.text: Identifies a time Interval during which a Thing occurs.

data.heading: CdmDataProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all data properties defined in the City Data Model.

data.heading: FoundationalCdmDataProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify data properties defined in the Foundation-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: CityUnitsDataProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify data properties defined in the City Units Pattern of the CDM ontology.

data.heading: hasRelativeYear
data.text: The base year used to define monetary values for a currency.

data.heading: RecurringEventDataProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined in the Recurring Event Properties Pattern of the CDM ontology.

data.heading: endTime
data.text: Specifies the end time of the domain object's activity.

data.heading: startTime
data.text: Specifies the start time of the RecurringEvent's activity using http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#time format.

data.heading: GeneralDataProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined in the General Properties Pattern of the CDM ontology.

data.heading: hasDescription
data.text: Descriptive information about an object.

data.heading: hasIdentifier
data.text: Unique identifier for an object.

data.heading: hasName
data.text: Name of an object.

data.heading: LocationDataProperty
data.text: Created for organizational purposes, to identify location data properties.

data.heading: isInvariant
data.text: Identifies whether a property is to be interpreted as invariant (i.e., its value is not subject to change over time).

data.heading: mainModule
data.text: Identifies whether an ontology file is the main ontology file within a directory.
